items.title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
items.summary: arXiv:2610.12536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-
items.summary_zh: EliteTable 是基于 LLM 的自改进程序搜索算法，利用固定容量高分方案表生成、编辑和混合新方案，并在六个 Gymnasium 控制任务上评估。
items.why_zh: 展示 LLM 引导的自改进程序搜索，可学习利用精英方案表进行策略生成与优化的可复用方法。

items.title: Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study
items.summary: arXiv:2610.12542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. All arms receive an identical budget - the same number of candidate schedules built and evaluated: an MCTS scheduling method, preregistered as the main arm; a randomized-restart
items.summary_zh: 在相同候选调度预算下，对比 MCTS 与随机重启列表调度在 DAG 工作流上的性能，检验简单方法是否同样有效。
items.why_zh: 说明在资源受限时如何公平比较搜索算法，可学习控制变量实验设计与调度算法评估方法。

items.title: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire
items.summary: arXiv:2610.12596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. items.summary_zh: 使用完整商业牌组 Slay the Spire 构建长 horizon 战略基准，评估 agentic 模型的长期规划能力。
items.why_zh: 提供长 horizon 战略推理评估框架，可学习将复杂游戏作为任务基准来测试模型规划与知识利用。

items.title: Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring
items.summary: StudentSim is a research system for evaluating and improving AI tutoring tools before they are tested with learners. It models how individuals may engage with tutors, giving feedback to improve tutor performance across subjects like chess, writing, and mathematics. The post Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.summary_zh: 提出 StudentSim 系统模拟学生行为，用于评估改进 AI 辅导工具。
items.why_zh: 学习如何用仿真环境评估和优化 AI 教学系统，掌握以数据驱动的迭代改进方法。

items.summary: Cognition President Russell Kaplan explains why developer priorities have flipped: once software tasks hit the saturation point where every model can do them well, speed and cost start to matter more than raw capability. This clip is from Max Agency, a podcast about how the best AI agents are actually being built. items.title: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
items.summary: TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available. The post TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: TII 发布 1.6B 参数的阿拉伯语语音识别模型 Falcon-ASR，在六套测试集上平均 WER 20.92%。
items.why_zh: 展示评估阿语 ASR 模型的技能，学会解读 WER 并注意模型权重与 API 可用性的实际影响。
